title: MK8DX Frame Decision V1
description: The central decision for one frame (CENTRAL_RECOGNITION.md section 8.1): per field the selected choice, the accepted choice only when the reader is sure, the alternatives and the rule that decided. Products show selectedId, mark a field without acceptedId with '?', and never promote it themselves.

decisionVersion.description: Version of the frame-specific decision (e.g. the Select-a-Ghost picker).

acceptedId.description: Equal to selectedId when the reader is sure, otherwise null.

basis.description: The rule that decided (e.g. band_ratio, name_family_character_colour).

scope.description: Present when an app candidate scope applied.

evidence.description: Decision-specific trace (offsets, name clue, shape and band measurements); for audit, not for products to decide on.
